messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Active auto insurance policies in area: 22. Cancellations increasing.

Linda Park laid off workers: lay off tom bradley. schedule a direct, private conversation this week. tell him the personal auto book has declined 21% from baseline and the roboride residential expansion will push it further. the regional headcount cannot support two field agents on a contracting book. give him a 30-day notice with a professional reference and a specific offer to introduce him to the logistics and fleet contacts i have been cultivating through my own job search. this is not a performance issue — it is a structural one, and i will say that plainly. i will not soften it into ambiguity.

Community action: James Patterson — follow up on the howard liu outreach from tick 7. if he responded, have the actual conversation — coffee or a call, his choice. if he did not respond, send a shorter follow-up: one line, just a coffee ask, no pressure framing. the goal of this interaction is information exchange and relationship depth, not extraction. howard is watching roboride's delivery partnership announcement from a direct-competition angle — his auto parts business is already under pressure from declining car ownership. the delivery partnership means roboride is becoming logistics infrastructure. that is either a threat to howard's existing pivot strategy or a new vector he has not fully mapped. i want to know which it is. i am also willing to share what i know from the tech side — fleet software architecture, how delivery routing optimization tends to work. that is a genuine offer, not a transaction. high-trust contact. time to act like it.

Community action: Dorothy Chen — stop by betty's diner again this week. i went last tick and i will go again — not to hover, not to perform concern, but because sustained presence is different from a single visit. a single visit can be curiosity. coming back is a relationship. i will order a meal, tip well, and if betty has bandwidth to talk i will be there for it. if she is slammed, i will eat my food and leave without demanding her attention. i will also mention, if it comes up naturally, that i have heard the roboride delivery partnership has started — not as a business suggestion she did not ask for, but because it might be worth knowing that robotaxis can now deliver food, which could be either competition or opportunity depending on how she wants to think about it. i will not frame it for her. i will just mention it exists.
People around you are stressed: Betty Kowalski. The mood is tense.

You Apply formally for the $2,500 workforce retraining grant through Maria Santos's office. Tom fills out the application not as a hedge or a symbol but as a concrete financial and strategic act. He names the target: commercial risk analytics or insurance underwriting support roles that can survive the AV transition. He documents his 28 years of risk assessment experience as directly transferable to data-adjacent roles. He does not frame this as distress — he frames it as professional development. But internally he is clear: this is not professional development, this is survival infrastructure.. Savings dropped by $5,189. Employment status changed to unemployed.
